description: Imports a song to use for a music video: either an audio file the user attached in ChatGPT (`file`) or a public link (`audioUrl`: a direct MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/OGG link or a public Suno song page). Exactly one of the two. Limits: up to 50 MB, longer than 5 seconds and at most 10 minutes. YouTube links are not supported. Copies the audio into the user's MusVideo storage; costs no credits. Returns a songId for create_mv_project. Only import music the user has the right to use.

audioUrl.description: Public https link to an audio file or a public Suno song page.

name: import_song
title: Import a song
